title: What If You Were Born With Infinite IQ?

title: What If It Never Stopped Raining for 10 Years?
tags: what if it never stopped raining
description:
What if the rain never stopped? Not for a week. Not for a year. For ten years.

You live on the 24th floor of a tower by the bay. On day six, the last evacuation bus leaves without you. What follows is a decade of catching rain from the roof, keeping warm without power, finding food that doesn't need the sun, dodging bull sharks in the streets, and watching saltwater eat your building from the inside.

The endless rain is fiction. The survival is real: atmospheric rivers, the Great Flood of 1862, the Year Without a Summer, bull sharks in floodwater, rebar corrosion, carbon monoxide, safe water. On day six, with that line around the corner, what would you have done? Tell me in the comments.

title: What If You Could See Everyone’s Lie Count?
description:
Above every face you look at, a red number: every lie that person has ever told. You're the only one who can see it.
You're a brand-new judge, proud you could always spot a liar. Nine days with the real thing change everything.

She's at the door, and you can see the number. Do you ask the questions, or say nothing and keep the life you had? Tell us which in the comments.

title: What If You Were the Only Man on an Island of 100 Amazons?
tags: what if you were the only man on an island
description:
▶ NEW VIDEO: What If You Could Heal Anyone With Your Hands? https://youtu.be/Crah_A8xhhE

What if you were the only man on an island of 100 Amazons? You wash up inside a ring of bronze spears, and you have thirty days to change their minds.

Your little sailboat hit a reef in a storm. The queen gives you one moon. On the thirtieth night, all one hundred warriors vote with their spears: if every spear goes up, you can stay forever; if even one stays down, the sea takes you back. The last man who washed up here, in 1987, got ninety-nine. You can't throw a spear, you can't swim the reef, and you can't make fire without a lighter. But back home you fix things for a living, and this island is about to need you.

Would you stay on the island forever, or go home? Tell us in the comments 👇

title: If The Diver Starts Banging On The Glass... RUN FAST
description:
If you're ever at an aquarium and the diver inside the thank suddenly starts banging on the glass. run fast. Don't wave at him. Don't knock back. And whatever you do, don't walk any closer to see what he's pointing at. There are 7 rules. Pay close attention to the fourth one.

This is an analog horror survival guide for a Saturday afternoon at the aquarium: the shark-feeding show, a diver who drops his bucket and pounds on the glass with both fists, a little boy who knocks three times, three knocks that come back from deep inside tha tank, a whiteboard pressed to the window that says DO NOT KNOCK BACK, a blue light that follows you through the underwater tunnel, two red eyes just above the glass, water spreading from under a locked maintenance door, a gallery glowing red, and a crack spreading across the window.

FILE 073 - TANK. Issued by the Department of Domestic Entities. Please listen to all steps.

CHAPTERS
0:00 If the aquarium diver starts banging on the glass
2:10 Rule 1: If something knocks back, step away from the glass
3:30 Rule 2: If every fish disappears, get away from the glass
4:24 The visitor's report 
5:03 Rule 3: If the blue light follows you, don't turn around
6:15 Rule 4: If the diver holds up both hands, stop moving
7:47 Rule 5: If the staff tell you to go back, don't follow them
8:39 The security guard's report
9:27 Rule 6: If the diver starts banging again, don't stop to watch
11:32 Rule 7: Leave NOW

ABOUT THESE FILES
Every file is one ordinary thing that stops acting ordinary, and the short list of rules that gets you home. No explanations. Just instructions

Yes, it's fiction. The Department does not exist, and nothing is living in the main tank. Real deep-sea anglerfish live thousands of feet down, most are smaller than a football, and they almost never survive being brought to the surface. In real life, if aquarium staff ask you to step back from a tank or leave an area, follow their directions. Everything else in this file is made up. All animation, music and sound effects are original.

title: What If You Could See Who Finds You Attractive?
description:
What if you could instantly see who finds you attractive? 👀❤️

Alex suddenly gains the ability to see a YES or NO above everyone's head, revealing whether they're attracted to the person they're looking at.

At first, it seems like the ultimate superpower. No more guessing, no more rejection, and no more wondering if your crush likes you.

But when Alex starts chasing every YES, he risks losing the one person who genuinely cares about him.

Would you want this ability?

title: What if You Were The Last Girl On Earth?
tags: what if you were the last girl alive
description:
Every woman on Earth disappears at 9:41 p.m. Except you. You're the last woman on Earth, and you have 100 years to stop humanity from dying out.

From the morning after to a secret lab, this is what would really happen if you were the last girl alive.

▶ The other side: What If You Were the Last Man on Earth? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XbXiFizyGko

0:00 Every woman disappears
0:26 The Morning After
2:16 The Last Bachelorette
4:33 The Math
5:55 The Lab
7:29 The Last Woman

Hospitals lose 9 in 10 nurses. Schools close. Millions of dads learn to make a bottle at 3 a.m. Every man on Earth wants a date, so you go undercover as Steve, pick the bear over the man, and team up with Admiral Doug Hartley and Dr. Kenji Mori. Then comes the math: one womb, about 300 eggs, and a world that shrinks to a few thousand people in 100 years. Can lab-grown eggs, artificial wombs and IVF save the human race?

Last man or last woman: which would you rather be? Tell us in the comments.

If you're struggling, call or text 988 (US) or find a helpline at findahelpline.com.

Our Sources:
- Share of nurses who are women: WHO, State of the World's Nursing 2020
- Male suicide rates: WHO global suicide estimates
- Most children born to one mother (69): Guinness World Records
- Eggs from male mice: Hayashi lab, Nature (2023)
- Human eggs made from skin cells: OHSU, Nature Communications (2025)
- Premature lambs in an artificial womb: CHOP, Nature Communications (2017)
- Mitochondrial Eve: Cann, Stoneking and Wilson, Nature (1987)
